title: Red Hat Security Advisory: patch security update
description: A filename validation bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-115207) in the patch program's reversal fallback allows an attacker to create files outside the intended working directory. This issue affects the patch utility used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. The vulnerability has been rated with moderate security impact by Red Hat Product Security. A security update addressing this flaw is available.
